qe: What is the correct mathematical expression for the induced magnetic field $B$ between the plates of a charging parallel-plate capacitor at a distance $r$ from the central axis?
qh: चार्जिंग के दौरान एक समानांतर-प्लेट कैपेसिटर की प्लेटों के बीच, केंद्रीय अक्ष से $r$ दूरी पर प्रेरित चुंबकीय क्षेत्र $B$ का सही गणितीय व्यंजक क्या है?
o: $$B = \mu_0 \varepsilon_0 \frac{dE}{dt}$$
$$B = \frac{\mu_0 \varepsilon_0 r}{2} \frac{dE}{dt}$$ (चुंबकीय क्षेत्र का सूत्र)
$$B = \frac{\mu_0 r^2}{2c} \frac{dE}{dt}$$
$$B = \frac{\mu_0 \varepsilon_0}{2r} \frac{dE}{dt}$$
e: Explanation: According to the Maxwell-Ampere law, the changing electric field between the plates induces a displacement current. The resulting magnetic field at a perpendicular distance $r$ from the axis is derived as $$B = \frac{\mu_0 \varepsilon_0 r}{2} \frac{dE}{dt}$$.

qe: Which specific dynamic process inside a charging parallel-plate capacitor acts as the source for creating a localized magnetic field between its plates?
qh: एक चार्जिंग समानांतर-प्लेट कैपेसिटर के भीतर कौन सी विशिष्ट गतिशील प्रक्रिया उसकी प्लेटों के बीच स्थानीयकृत चुंबकीय क्षेत्र बनाने के स्रोत के रूप में कार्य करती है?
o: The steady flow of conduction electrons across the dielectric gap
The time-varying electric field generating a displacement current (समय के साथ बदलते विद्युत क्षेत्र द्वारा विस्थापन धारा का निर्माण)
The permanent chemical cross-linking of surface carbon molecules
The accumulation of stationary positive ions along the central axis
e: Explanation: James Clerk Maxwell established that a time-varying electric field or changing electric flux ($$\frac{d\Phi_E}{dt}$$) acts precisely like a conventional conduction current. This process sets up a displacement current ($$I_d = \varepsilon_0 \frac{d\Phi_E}{dt}$$) which generates the localized magnetic field.

qe: Which specific wave group within the electromagnetic spectrum is standardly deployed to coordinate long-range satellite communication paths?
qh: विद्युत चुंबकीय स्पेक्ट्रम के किस विशिष्ट तरंग समूह का उपयोग मानक रूप से लंबी दूरी के उपग्रह संचार (satellite communication) मार्गों को समन्वित करने के लिए किया जाता है?
o: Low-frequency ground waves traveling near topsoil
Microwaves (माइक्रोवेव / सूक्ष्म तरंगें)
Infrared thermal radiation tracking parameters
High-energy cosmic rays crossing grids
e: Explanation: Microwaves possess high frequencies (ranging from $1\text{ GHz}$ to $300\text{ GHz}$) and short wavelengths. This enables them to pass straight through the Earth's ionosphere without reflection or significant scattering, making them uniquely suited for satellite links.

qe: Which type of electromagnetic radiation is utilized inside commercial water filtration systems to effectively destroy harmful germs and biological microbes?
qh: हानिकारक कीटाणुओं और जैविक सूक्ष्मजीवों को प्रभावी ढंग से नष्ट करने के लिए व्यावसायिक जल निस्पंदन प्रणालियों के भीतर किस प्रकार के विद्युत चुंबकीय विकिरण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
o: Thermal infrared heat bands
Ultraviolet rays / UV light (पराबैंगनी किरणें / UV light)
Low-frequency radio broadcasting signals
Long-wavelength microwave emissions
e: Explanation: Ultraviolet (UV) rays are highly energetic. When microorganisms are exposed to UV light, the radiation breaks and disrupts the chemical bonds inside their nucleic acids (DNA/RNA), killing them or rendering them unable to replicate.

qe: Which specific category of electromagnetic waves is applied to scan and locate micro leakages within buried underground oil pipelines?
qh: जमीन के नीचे दबी तेल पाइपलाइनों के भीतर सूक्ष्म रिसाव (micro leakages) को स्कैन करने और उनका पता लगाने के लिए विद्युत चुंबकीय तरंगों की किस विशिष्ट श्रेणी को लागू किया जाता है?
o: Visible light spectrum streams
X-rays (एक्स-रे / X-rays)
Extremely low-frequency alternating lines
Non-polar surface tracking waves
e: Explanation: X-rays possess high frequency and exceptional penetrating power. In industrial radiography, they are utilized to pass through soil and dense pipeline walls to construct detailed structural profiles that highlight cracks or fluid leaks.

qe: Which band of the electromagnetic spectrum is utilized in airport infrastructure to stabilize visibility parameters for pilots navigating runways facing dense fog and mist?
qh: घने कोहरे और धुंध का सामना करने वाले रनवे पर पायलटों के लिए दृश्यता मापदंडों को स्थिर करने के लिए हवाई अड्डे के बुनियादी ढांचे में विद्युत चुंबकीय स्पेक्ट्रम के किस बैंड का उपयोग किया जाता है?
o: Short-wavelength ultraviolet lines
Infrared radiation (अवरक्त विकिरण / Infrared)
Gamma ray atomic emission tracks
Standard visible blue light frequencies
e: Explanation: Fog and mist scatter visible light heavily due to Rayleigh scattering constraints. Because infrared radiation features longer wavelengths than visible light, it scatters significantly less through small water droplets, allowing thermographic sensors to outline runways clearly.

qe: What is the correct ascending order based on the baseline wavelengths of Ultraviolet rays, Microwaves, X-rays, and Infrared waves?
qh: पराबैंगनी किरणों (UV), माइक्रोवेव, एक्स-रे और अवरक्त (Infrared) तरंगों के तरंगदैर्ध्य के आधार पर उनका सही बढ़ता क्रम (ascending order) क्या है?
o: $$\lambda_{\text{Microwave}} < \lambda_{\text{Infrared}} < \lambda_{\text{UV}} < \lambda_{\text{X-rays}}$$
$$\lambda_{\text{X-rays}} < \lambda_{\text{UV}} < \lambda_{\text{Infrared}} < \lambda_{\text{Microwave}}$$ (तरंगदैर्ध्य का बढ़ता क्रम)
$$\lambda_{\text{UV}} < \lambda_{\text{X-rays}} < \lambda_{\text{Microwave}} < \lambda_{\text{Infrared}}$$
$$\lambda_{\text{Infrared}} < \lambda_{\text{Microwave}} < \lambda_{\text{X-rays}} < \lambda_{\text{UV}}$$
e: Explanation: In the complete electromagnetic spectrum, wavelength scales inversely with frequency. Tracking from shortest to longest wavelength: X-rays ($$10^{-10}\text{ m}$$) $$\rightarrow$$ Ultraviolet ($$10^{-8}\text{ m}$$) $$\rightarrow$$ Infrared ($$10^{-5}\text{ m}$$) $$\rightarrow$$ Microwaves ($$10^{-2}\text{ m}$$).

qe: What primary biomedical application utilizes ultraviolet (UV) laser radiation outside of standard fluid sterilization tasks?
qh: मानक द्रव नसबंदी कार्यों के बाहर कौन सा प्राथमिक जैव-चिकित्सा अनुप्रयोग पराबैंगनी (UV) लेजर विकिरण का उपयोग करता है?
o: Thermal destruction of internal deep tissue tumors
LASIK eye surgery to reshape the corneal tissue layer (लिविंग कॉर्नियल ऊतक को नया आकार देने के लिए LASIK सर्जरी)
The fast synthesis of volatile non-polar polymer bone fills
Mapping single nucleotide tracking charts across blood streams
e: Explanation: High-precision excimer lasers emitting ultraviolet light are heavily utilized in LASIK refractive eye surgeries. The high energy allows the laser to cleave chemical bonds in living corneal tissue with extreme accuracy without introducing heat damage to adjacent structures.

qe: What is the mathematical expression for the average value of the radiant flux density ($S_{\text{av}}$), or Poynting vector magnitude, over a single complete wave cycle in a vacuum?
qh: निर्वात में एक एकल पूर्ण तरंग चक्र में औसत दीप्तिमान प्रवाह घनत्व ($S_{\text{av}}$), या पॉइंटिंग वेक्टर परिमाण का सही गणितीय सूत्र क्या है?
o: $$S_{\text{av}} = c \cdot \varepsilon_0 \cdot E_0$$
$$S_{\text{av}} = \frac{1}{2} c \varepsilon_0 E_0^2 = \frac{E_0^2}{2 c \mu_0}$$ (औसत पॉइंटिंग वेक्टर मान)
$$S_{\text{av}} = \frac{\varepsilon_0 E_0^2}{2c}$$
$$S_{\text{av}} = nF \cdot E_0^2 \cdot \mu_0$$
e: Explanation: The instantaneous Poynting vector is given by $$\vec{S} = \frac{1}{\mu_0} (\vec{E} \times \vec{B})$$. Integrating its magnitude over a full sinusoidal harmonic time period $T$ yields an average energy flux density or intensity of $$S_{\text{av}} = \frac{1}{2} c \varepsilon_0 E_0^2 = \frac{E_0^2}{2 c \mu_0}$$.

qe: What operational criteria must an electronic hardware designer satisfy to establish a stable, continuous displacement current within a capacitor's dielectric space?
qh: एक कैपेसिटर के ढांकता हुआ स्थान (dielectric space) के भीतर एक स्थिर, निरंतर विस्थापन धारा स्थापित करने के लिए एक इलेक्ट्रॉनिक हार्डवेयर डिजाइनर को किस शर्त को पूरा करना होगा?
o: Maintain a strictly static unvarying DC voltage baseline
Maintain a continuously varying potential difference over time (समय के साथ लगातार बदलते रहने वाले विभवांतर को बनाए रखना)
Isolate the capacitor grid inside a permanent absolute vacuum
Coordinate the step-growth polymerization of adjacent amino residues
e: Explanation: Displacement current requires a changing electric flux ($$I_d = \varepsilon_0 \frac{d\Phi_E}{dt}$$). Since electric flux scales linearly with plate voltage ($$\Phi_E \propto V$$), the designer must apply a time-varying or alternating potential difference ($$\frac{dV}{dt} \neq 0$$) across the terminals.

qe: What analytical expression calculates the net radiation pressure ($p$) developed when an electromagnetic wave of constant intensity $I$ undergoes total absorption on a surface in a vacuum?
qh: जब स्थिरांक तीव्रता $I$ की एक विद्युत चुंबकीय तरंग निर्वात में एक सतह पर पूर्ण अवशोषण (total absorption) से गुजरती है, तो उत्पन्न शुद्ध विकिरण दबाव ($p$) की गणना किस सूत्र से की जाती है?
o: $$p = I \cdot c$$ velocity propagation product
$$p = \frac{I}{c}$$ (पूर्ण अवशोषण के लिए विकिरण दबाव का सूत्र)
$$p = \frac{2I}{c}$$ extensive reflection threshold
$$p = \frac{I}{c^2}$$ monomeric core addition layout
e: Explanation: Radiation pressure equals the rate of momentum transfer per unit area. Since momentum delivered per unit time per unit area is $$\frac{I}{c}$$, a surface that completely absorbs the incoming wave experiences a linear radiation pressure of exactly $$p = \frac{I}{c}$$.

qe: How does the net intensity ($I$) of electromagnetic radiation emitted by a common isotropic point source scale if the distance ($r$) from the filament center is exactly doubled?
qh: यदि एक सामान्य समदैशिक बिंदु स्रोत (isotropic point source) से दूरी ($r$) को बिल्कुल दोगुना कर दिया जाए, तो उत्सर्जित विद्युत चुंबकीय विकिरण की शुद्ध तीव्रता ($I$) कैसे बदलती है?
o: The intensity values remain perfectly constant matching fields
The intensity decreases to one-fourth of its initial value (तीव्रता घटकर प्रारंभिक मान का एक-चौथाई हो जाना)
The intensity doubles due to high structural density shifts
The magnitude collapses down cleanly to an absolute zero baseline
e: Explanation: An isotropic point source radiates energy uniformly in three dimensions across expanding spherical wavefronts. Because area scales as $$4\pi r^2$$, the net power per unit area drops according to the inverse-square law: $$I \propto \frac{1}{r^2}$$. Doubling $r$ cuts intensity to $$\frac{1}{4}$$.

qe: Why does a laser beam maintain near-constant intensity across a room, whereas the intensity of an incandescent light bulb degrades rapidly with distance?
qh: एक लेजर बीम पूरे कमरे में लगभग स्थिर तीव्रता क्यों बनाए रखती है, जबकि एक साधारण गरमागरम गरमी के बल्ब की तीव्रता दूरी के साथ तेजी से घटती है?
o: Because lasers convert surrounding air molecules into rigid plastics
A laser beam is highly directional, coherent, and collimated, preventing its wavefront from spreading out spherically over distance (लेजर बीम का अत्यधिक दिशात्मक और समानांतर होना)
Because lasers eliminate the dynamic dielectric constant of vacuum
Because the laser utilizes cross-linked phenolic matrices to guide rays
e: Explanation: Unlike an incandescent bulb which emits incoherent light divergent in all directions ($$I \propto \frac{1}{r^2}$$), a laser beam exhibits high spatial coherence and highly collimated, parallel rays. This prevents geometric beam spreading over long paths, maintaining near-constant intensity.

qe: Why does the oscillating electric field of an electromagnetic wave fail to contribute to the net radiation pressure on a surface, despite executing a physical force ($q\vec{E}$) on individual charged particles?
qh: व्यक्तिगत आवेशित कणों पर भौतिक बल ($q\vec{E}$) लगाने के बावजूद, एक विद्युत चुंबकीय तरंग का दोलायमान विद्युत क्षेत्र सतह पर शुद्ध विकिरण दबाव में योगदान क्यों नहीं दे पाता है?
o: The electric field molecules undergo rapid homolytic breakdown loops
The electric field vector alternates direction rapidly over time, causing its net force averaged over a full cycle to resolve to zero (विद्युत बल का चक्र औसत शून्य होना)
The electric fields lack any ionizable phosphate backbone coordinates
The field forces adjacent elements to combine into solid unbranched starches
e: Explanation: The electric field vector of a propagating electromagnetic wave reverses its direction symmetrically every half-cycle. Because the field executes rapid harmonic oscillations, the net electric force exerted on a charged particle, when integrated over an integral number of cycles, resolves completely to zero.

qe: What fundamental physical parameter did Professor CV Raman demonstrate when he successfully suspended a tiny light ball inside a transparent vacuum chamber using a laser beam?
qh: प्रोफेसर सीवी रमन ने क्या मौलिक भौतिक पैरामीटर प्रदर्शित किया था जब उन्होंने एक लेजर बीम का उपयोग करके एक पारदर्शी निर्वात कक्ष के भीतर एक छोटी, हल्की गेंद को स्वतंत्र रूप से हवा में लटका दिया था?
o: The continuous free-radical polymerization of structural dipeptides
That electromagnetic waves carry linear momentum and exert a physical force per unit area known as radiation pressure (यह कि विद्युत चुंबकीय तरंगें संवेग ले जाती हैं और विकिरण दबाव लगाती हैं)
The conversion of sugar backbones into unbranched linear caprolactam lines
The induction of standard cell electrode potential drops across materials
e: Explanation: By balancing the downward gravitational force of the ball with an upward laser beam, CV Raman demonstrated that electromagnetic waves carry linear momentum ($$p = \frac{U}{c}$$). Upon interacting with a surface, this momentum transfer exerts a macroscopic mechanical force termed radiation pressure.

qe: What is the mathematical definition of the Poynting vector $\vec{S}$, which tracks the directional energy flux density of an electromagnetic wave?
qh: विद्युत चुंबकीय तरंग के दिशात्मक ऊर्जा प्रवाह घनत्व (energy flux density) को ट्रैक करने वाले पॉइंटिंग वेक्टर $\vec{S}$ की सही गणितीय परिभाषा क्या है?
o: $$\vec{S} = \mu_0 (\vec{E} \times \vec{B})$$
$$\vec{S} = \frac{1}{\mu_0} (\vec{E} \times \vec{B})$$ (पॉइंटिंग वेक्टर की परिभाषा)
$$\vec{S} = c \cdot \varepsilon_0 (\vec{B} \times \vec{E})$$
$$\vec{S} = \frac{\varepsilon_0}{\mu_0} (\vec{E} \cdot \vec{B})$$
e: Explanation: In classical electrodynamics, the energy flow per unit time per unit area transported by electromagnetic fields is mathematically represented by the Poynting vector, defined strictly through the cross product relation: $$\vec{S} = \frac{1}{\mu_0} (\vec{E} \times \vec{B})$$.

qe: What is the physical significance of the direction mapped out by the cross product $\vec{E} \times \vec{B}$ in an electromagnetic plane wave?
qh: एक विद्युत चुंबकीय समतल तरंग में क्रॉस उत्पाद $\vec{E} \times \vec{B}$ द्वारा मैप की गई दिशा का भौतिक महत्व क्या है?
o: It represents the longitudinal orientation of ionic lattice positions
It maps the precise directional trajectory of energy transport and wave propagation (यह ऊर्जा परिवहन और तरंग संचरण की दिशा को दर्शाता है)
It marks the structural alignment of covalent methylene cross-links
It identifies the zero-velocity baseline axis inside collection wells
e: Explanation: For any transverse electromagnetic wave, the electric field vector $$\vec{E}$$ and magnetic field vector $$\vec{B}$$ oscillate perpendicularly to each other. The cross product $$\vec{E} \times \vec{B}$$ yields a vector that points strictly along the direction of wave propagation and energy flow.

qe: Which specific internal electronic cell line inside a human host is aggressively targeted and occupied by HIV, converting it into a replication facility?
qh: मानव मेजबान के भीतर किस विशिष्ट आंतरिक प्रतिरक्षा कोशिका रेखा (cell line) को HIV द्वारा आक्रामक रूप से लक्षित और कब्जा कर लिया जाता है, जिससे वह वायरस की फैक्ट्री में बदल जाती है?
o: Annucleated mature red blood cells
Macrophages and Helper T-lymphocytes containing matching CD4 receptors (मैक्रोफेज एवं हेल्पर टी-कोशिकाएं / CD4 रिसेप्टर कोशिकाएं)
Cationic platelets floating in serum reservoirs
Bone marrow structural fibroblasts
e: Explanation: HIV preferentially invades host cells expressing surface CD4 glycoprotein markers. It targets macrophages and helper T-lymphocytes ($T_H$ cells), reverse-transcribing its viral RNA into DNA to hijack the host genome and turn these cells into viral production factories.

qe: What structural attribute characterises the genomic classification of a retrovirus like HIV?
qh: HIV जैसे रेट्रोवायरस (retrovirus) के जीनोमिक वर्गीकरण की मुख्य संरचनात्मक विशेषता क्या है?
o: A double-stranded circular DNA plasmid vector loop
A single-stranded RNA core template alongside the catalytic enzyme reverse transcriptase (सिंगल-स्ट्रैंडेड आरएनए कोर एवं रिवर्स ट्रांसक्रिप्टेज एंजाइम)
An amorphous cross-linked network layer held by stable disulfide bridges
An open-chain carbohydrate mesh held strictly by glycosidic links
e: Explanation: Retroviruses belong to an unconventional class of RNA viruses. Their genome consists of single-stranded RNA molecules packed with the enzyme reverse transcriptase, which allows the virus to synthesize a DNA copy from its RNA template within the host cytoplasm.

qe: Why do advanced AIDS patients experience severe vulnerability to minor opportunistic infections like *Mycobacterium* or unconventional fungal invasions?
qh: एड्स (AIDS) के गंभीर मरीज माइकोबैक्टीरियम या असामान्य कवक संक्रमण जैसे छोटे-मोटे संक्रामक रोगों के प्रति भी अत्यधिक संवेदनशील क्यों हो जाते हैं?
o: The sudden spontaneous precipitation of all plasma components
A drastic, systematic drop in the absolute count of functional Helper T-lymphocytes (हेल्पर टी-कोशिकाओं की संख्या में भारी गिरावट आ जाना)
The direct conversion of bone marrow into a volatile polyolefin tail layer
The complete cross-linking of structural antibody links via stable single bonds
e: Explanation: Because HIV selectively replicates within and destroys helper T-cells ($T_H$ cells), the body's absolute helper T-cell count falls drastically over time. Since these cells are responsible for activating both B-cell antibody production and cytotoxic T-cell responses, their collapse leaves the adaptive immune system crippled against common opportunistic pathogens.

qe: What explicit biochemical validation test is deployed as the primary diagnostic screen to detect the presence of HIV antibodies in a patient's serum?
qh: रोगी के सीरम में HIV एंटीबॉडी की उपस्थिति का पता लगाने के लिए प्राथमिक नैदानिक स्क्रीन के रूप में कौन सा विशिष्ट जैव रासायनिक परीक्षण तैनात किया जाता है?
o: The Northern blotting analysis tracking RNA footprints
The Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay / ELISA test (एलिसा परीक्षण / ELISA Test)
The agarose gel electrophoresis sieve matrix check
The free-radical benzoyl peroxide indicator scan
e: Explanation: The primary serological diagnostic screening tool used to confirm an HIV infection is the Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay (ELISA). It operates by detecting the presence of specific anti-HIV antibodies synthesized by the host's immune system in response to viral antigens.

qe: What specialized cellular property is completely lost when normal mammalian cells undergo transformation into highly malignant cancer cells?
qh: जब सामान्य स्तनधारी कोशिकाएं (mammalian cells) अत्यधिक घातक कैंसर कोशिकाओं में बदल जाती हैं, तो कौन सा विशिष्ट कोशिकीय गुण पूरी तरह से समाप्त हो जाता है?
o: The homolytic cleavage of carbon-carbon single bonds
Contact Inhibition (संपर्क संदमन / कांटेक्ट इनहिबिशन)
The synthesis of linear synthetic polyamide strings
The baseline capacity to bind negative phosphate matrices
e: Explanation: Normal somatic cells display contact inhibition, meaning cell replication halts once they make physical contact with adjacent cells. Malignant cancer cells completely lose this regulatory constraint, dividing continuously to form abnormal masses (tumors) that overrun tissue boundaries.

qe: Which high-precision diagnostic imaging technology applies non-ionizing magnetic fields and radiofrequency waves to map soft tissue abnormalities without radiation hazards?
qh: कौन सी उच्च-सटीक नैदानिक इमेजिंग तकनीक विकिरण खतरों के बिना नरम ऊतक (soft tissue) की असामान्यताओं का नक्शा बनाने के लिए गैर-आयनीकरण चुंबकीय क्षेत्रों और रेडियो तरंगों को लागू करती है?
o: Standard computed tomography (CT) scanning loops
Magnetic Resonance Imaging / MRI (एमआरआई / MRI)
The basic free-radical benzoyl peroxide indicator scan
The unbranched starch verification matrix chart
e: Explanation: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) employs strong, non-ionizing magnetic fields and radiofrequency waves to excite nuclear spins (primarily hydrogen protons in water molecules) inside living tissues. Tracking relaxation times yields high-contrast 3D maps of soft tissues without radiation risks.

qe: Why do conventional laboratory urinalysis or simple blood counts fail to enable early detection of viral pathologies compared to modern molecular tools like PCR?
qh: आधुनिक आणविक उपकरणों (जैसे PCR) की तुलना में पारंपरिक प्रयोगशाला मूत्र विश्लेषण या सरल रक्त गणना वायरल रोगों का जल्दी पता लगाने में क्यों विफल रहती है?
o: They completely convert passing elements into volatile gases
They require the virus to multiply to massive concentrations or induce visible clinical damage before registering a positive signal (प्रारंभिक अवस्था में वायरस की सूक्ष्म मात्रा को न पहचान पाना)
They rely exclusively on toxic arsenic cross-linked bridges
They freeze cell wall structures into an uncharged polymer matrix
e: Explanation: Conventional diagnostic tests rely on detecting macro-symptoms or down-stream secondary antibodies. Early in an infection, viral particle counts are too low to trigger these metrics. Molecular tools like the Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) bypass this by amplifying trace amounts of viral DNA/RNA directly, enabling immediate early detection.

qe: Which specific organic compound present within tobacco processing directly triggers the quick release of catecholamines from the human adrenal medulla?
qh: तंबाकू प्रसंस्करण के भीतर मौजूद कौन सा विशिष्ट कार्बनिक यौगिक सीधे मानव एड्रिनल मेडुला से कैटेकोलामाइन (catecholamines) के त्वरित स्राव को ट्रिगर करता है?
o: Morphine base crystal fractions
Nicotine (निकोटिन)
Cannabinoid open-chain resins
Lysergic acid diethyl derivatives
e: Explanation: Tobacco contains the toxic alkaloid nicotine. Upon entering the bloodstream, nicotine acts directly as a potent agonist on nicotinic acetylcholine receptors within the adrenal medulla, stimulating the rapid secretion of adrenaline and noradrenaline into circulation.

qe: What dangerous gas molecule accumulates within a tobacco smoker's circulatory system, forcefully displacing oxygen from binding coordinates along hemoglobin chains?
qh: तंबाकू धूम्रपान करने वाले के परिसंचरण तंत्र के भीतर कौन सा खतरनाक गैस अणु जमा हो जाता है, जो हीमोग्लोबिन श्रृंखलाओं के साथ ऑक्सीजन के जुड़ने को जबरन विस्थापित करता है?
o: Pure nitrogen gas fumes
Carbon Monoxide / CO (कार्बन मोनोऑक्साइड / CO)
Volatile petroleum ether gas fractions
Fluorinated vinylic addition monomers
e: Explanation: Tobacco smoke contains high concentrations of Carbon Monoxide ($CO$). Carbon monoxide binds to the active iron binding coordinates of hemoglobin over 200 times more tightly than oxygen, forming stable carboxyhemoglobin complexes that cause systemic hypoxia.

qe: Where along a transfer RNA (tRNA) adapter molecule are the specific triplet bases located that interact with matching messenger RNA codons during translation?
qh: एक ट्रांसफर आरएनए (tRNA) एडेप्टर अणु पर विशिष्ट ट्रिप्लेट बेस (triplet bases) कहाँ स्थित होते हैं जो अनुवाद के दौरान मैसेंजर आरएनए कोडन के साथ जुड़ते हैं?
o: The terminal amino acid acceptor stem domain
The Anticodon loop (एंटीकोडन लूप / anticodon loop)
The unbranched non-ionic variable arm tail
The highly reactive internal dihydroxyuridine pocket
e: Explanation: The specific tracking site responsible for reading the genetic dictionary on an mRNA strand is located on the exposed tip of the tRNA called the anticodon loop. It contains a triplet sequence of bases complementary to the target mRNA codon.

qe: What structural nomenclature describes the compact three-dimensional tertiary conformation of a functional transfer RNA molecule?
qh: एक कार्यात्मक ट्रांसफर आरएनए (tRNA) अणु के कॉम्पैक्ट त्रि-आयामी (3D) तृतीयक विन्यास का वर्णन करने के लिए क्या नाम दिया गया है?
o: The symmetric clover-leaf secondary layout format
The compact inverted L-shaped configuration (उल्टा L-आकार विन्यास)
The unbranched dicarboxylic straight alkane tail block
A cross-linked urea-formaldehyde polymer matrix sheet
e: Explanation: While secondary structure base-pairing maps look like a flat two-dimensional clover-leaf layout, physical X-ray diffraction analyses prove that tertiary folding forces a functional tRNA molecule to fold into a compact, inverted L-shaped conformation.

qe: What precise nucleotide sequence marks the absolute single-stranded 3' coordinate terminus where an activated amino acid anchors onto a tRNA molecule?
qh: तन्मयता से अनुवाद के दौरान एक सक्रिय अमीनो एसिड ट्रांसफर आरएनए (tRNA) अणु के किस विशिष्ट 3' छोर के न्यूक्लियोटाइड अनुक्रम पर आकर जुड़ता है?
o: A long lipophilic carbon chain containing chlorine atoms
The single-stranded 5'-CCA-3' hydroxyl sequence (5'-CCA-3' अनुक्रम)
The automated AUG initiation codon sequence matrix
The non-coding polyadenylation tail array
e: Explanation: Every functional tRNA molecule finishes its 3' amino acid acceptor stem with a conserved single-stranded $5'\text{-CCA-}3'$ layout. The terminal adenosine residue supplies the free hydroxyl group required to form a covalent ester bond with an activated amino acid.

qe: What multi-protein cell assembly incorporates an siRNA strand to locate and slice complementary mRNA molecules within the cytoplasm during post-transcriptional gene silencing?
qh: पोस्ट-ट्रांसक्रिप्शनल जीन साइलेंसिंग के दौरान साइटोप्लाज्म के भीतर पूरक mRNA अणुओं को लक्षित करने और काटने के लिए कौन सा जटिल सेलुलर मल्टीप्रोटीन असेंबली काम करती है?
o: Ziegler-Natta coordination template polymerization system
RISC / RNA-Induced Silencing Complex (रिस्क कॉम्प्लेक्स / RISC)
The human spliceosome intron-cleaving network mapping model
A cross-linked urea-formaldehyde polymer matrix sheet
e: Explanation: In the RNA interference (RNAi) pathway, small interfering RNAs (siRNAs) assemble with proteins to form the RNA-Induced Silencing Complex (RISC). RISC uses the integrated antisense RNA strand as a guide to pair with and enzymatically cleave complementary target mRNA transcripts.

qe: What operational term specifies chemical additives that systematically reduce the base rate of a chemical reaction without altering the surface of a solid catalyst?
qh: उन रासायनिक पदार्थों को क्या कहा जाता है जो एक ठोस उत्प्रेरक की सतह को बदले बिना किसी रासायनिक प्रतिक्रिया की आधार दर को व्यवस्थित रूप से कम (reduce) कर देते हैं?
o: Reaction promoters and chemical activators
Inhibitors or Retarders (अवरोधक या मंदक / Inhibitors)
Cationic quaternary ammonium halide variants
Inorganic dicarboxylic alkaline matrix builders
e: Explanation: Chemical agents that decrease or halt the velocity of a chemical reaction by binding with reactants or blocking reactive radical loops are classified as inhibitors or reaction retarders.

qe: Which strong covalent bond links consecutive nucleotide monomers together along a single strand of DNA or RNA?
qh: कौन सा मजबूत सहसंयोजक बंध डीएनए या आरएनए के एक एकल धागे (single strand) के साथ लगातार न्यूक्लियोटाइड मोनोमर्स को एक साथ जोड़ता है?
o: N-glycosidic link bridging rings together
3'-5' phosphodiester linkage (3'-5' फॉस्फोडिएस्टर बंध)
Amide linkage systematically identical to a biological peptide bond
Sulfur disulfide cross-link bridge system anchoring paths
e: Explanation: Nucleotides fold sequentially into polymers via 3'-5' phosphodiester linkages. This covalent bridge connects the 3'-hydroxyl group of one pentose sugar to the 5'-phosphate group of the next nucleotide.

qe: What molecular arrangement details the relative directionality of the twin strands forming a classic B-DNA double helix model?
qh: एक क्लासिक B-DNA डबल हेलिक्स मॉडल बनाने वाले दो धागों की सापेक्ष दिशात्मकता (relative directionality) को कौन सा आणविक विन्यास दर्शाता है?
o: They run parallel in the exact same 5' to 3' spatial direction
They exhibit anti-parallel polarity, where one strand runs 5' to 3' and the other runs 3' to 5' (प्रति-समानांतर ध्रुवता / anti-parallel)
They are arranged as separate open-chain unlinked carbohydrate blocks
They cross-link randomly into a single infusible thermosetting net plastic
e: Explanation: The twin strands of a DNA double helix run anti-parallel to one another. One strand is oriented in the 5' to 3' direction, while its complementary counter-strand features a reverse 3' to 5' alignment.

qe: What structural feature characterises the alpha-helix secondary structure of a protein, keeping the right-handed screw conformation stable?
qh: कौन सी संरचनात्मक विशेषता एक प्रोटीन की अल्फा-हेलिक्स माध्यमिक संरचना की विशेषता है, जो दाहिने हाथ की पेंच जैसी आकृति को स्थिर रखती है?
o: Weak van der Waals forces acting uniformly across non-polar branches
Intramolecular hydrogen bonds formed between the N-H group of an amino acid residue and the carbonyl C=O group of an adjacent turn (N-H और C=O के बीच हाइड्रोजन बंध)
Reversible ester links that undergo rapid reduction with basic catalysts
Cationic quaternary nitrogen halide cross-linked coordination zones
e: Explanation: The helical conformation of an $\alpha$-helix is locked and stabilized by a dense network of regular hydrogen bonds. These form between the polar amide $N-H$ groups situated along one loop of the coiling backbone and the carbonyl $C=O$ functional groups of the adjacent turn.

qe: What sequencing workflow strategy was deployed during the Human Genome Project to exclusively map and isolate regions that code for active RNA transcripts?
qh: मानव जीनोम प्रोजेक्ट के दौरान केवल उन क्षेत्रों को मैप और अलग करने के लिए किस अनुक्रमण रणनीति (sequencing strategy) को तैनात किया गया था जो सक्रिय आरएनए प्रतिलेखों को कोड करते हैं?
o: Blind sequence annotation blueprint runs
Expressed Sequence Tags / ESTs (व्यक्त अनुक्रम टैग / ESTs)
Homolytic chain termination step testing
Monomeric ring-opening condensation arrays
e: Explanation: The strategy focused explicitly on identifying all genes that are expressed as functional transcripts. This targeted methodology is designated as Expressed Sequence Tags (ESTs), separating coding genes from vast genomic non-coding sequences.

qe: What is the structural pitch dimension of a single complete turn of a standard B-DNA double helix along its vertical axis?
qh: मानक B-DNA डबल हेलिक्स के उसके ऊर्ध्वाधर अक्ष पर एक एकल पूर्ण मोड़ का संरचनात्मक पिच आयाम (pitch dimension) क्या होता है?
o: 0.34 nanometers absolute width
3.4 nanometers (3.4 नैनोमीटर)
34 nanometers extensive length
2.2 meters absolute macro profile
e: Explanation: In a standard B-DNA model developed by Watson and Crick, a single complete helical turn around the central axis covers an axial displacement distance of exactly $3.4\text{ nm}$ ($34\text{ \AA}$).

qe: What is the calculated spacing interval between consecutive base pairs along the vertical axis of a standard B-DNA double helix?
qh: एक मानक B-DNA डबल हेलिक्स के ऊर्ध्वाधर अक्ष के साथ लगातार क्षारक युग्मों (base pairs) के बीच की दूरी का मान क्या होता है?
o: 3.4 nanometers total length
0.34 nanometers (0.34 नैनोमीटर)
20 nanometers structural area width
4.6 nanometers calculated index
e: Explanation: Each complete single turn of a B-DNA double helix spans $3.4\text{ nm}$ and accommodates exactly ten base pairs. Therefore, the distance or step interval separating consecutive stacked base pairs is $3.4 / 10 = 0.34\text{ nm}$ ($3.4\text{ \AA}$).

qe: What name is assigned to the final processing operations in commercial biotechnology where expressed recombinant proteins are systematically separated and purified?
qh: वाणिज्यिक जैव प्रौद्योगिकी में अंतिम प्रसंस्करण कार्यों को क्या नाम दिया गया है जहां व्यक्त किए गए पुनः संयोजक प्रोटीन (recombinant proteins) को व्यवस्थित रूप से अलग और शुद्ध किया जाता है?
o: Upstream radical propagation paths
Downstream processing (डाउनस्ट्रीम प्रोसेसिंग / अनुप्रवाह संसाधन)
Homolytic chain termination steps
Monomeric ring-opening extraction lines
e: Explanation: Downstream processing includes all operations performed on a harvested biological culture to isolate, separate, and purify the target product, ensuring it meets commercial purity and safety standards before marketing.

qe: What thermodynamic criteria must be satisfied regarding cell voltage potential ($E_{\text{cell}}$) and Gibbs free energy change ($\Delta G$) for an electrochemical reaction to proceed spontaneously?
qh: एक विद्युत रासायनिक प्रतिक्रिया के स्वतः स्फूर्त (spontaneous) होने के लिए सेल वोल्टेज विभव ($E_{\text{cell}}$) और गिब्स मुक्त ऊर्जा परिवर्तन ($\Delta G$) के संबंध में किन मानदंडों को पूरा किया जाना चाहिए?
o: $$E_{\text{cell}}$$ must be negative, and $$\Delta G$$ must be positive
$$E_{\text{cell}}$$ must be positive, and $$\Delta G$$ must be negative (E_cell धनात्मक तथा \Delta G ऋणात्मक)
Both must maintain identical positive charge states simultaneously
Both must drop to zero absolute neutral indicators
e: Explanation: Spontaneous electrochemical or redox processes require a negative Gibbs Free Energy change ($$\Delta G < 0$$) and a matching positive cell voltage potential ($$E_{\text{cell}} > 0$$).

qe: What physical status characterizes the continuous, erratic, zig-zag path traveled by colloidal particles suspended inside a liquid dispersion medium?
qh: एक तरल परिक्षेपण माध्यम (dispersion medium) के भीतर निलंबित कोलाइडल कणों द्वारा तय किए गए निरंतर अनियमित टेढ़े-मेढ़े मार्ग की विशेषता क्या कहलाती है?
o: Electrophoresis displacement lines
Brownian movement (ब्राउनियन गति)
Tyndall light diffraction layout
Coagulation network fixing zones
e: Explanation: Brownian motion is the continuous, erratic, zig-zag movement of colloidal particles suspended in a dispersion medium, driven by the constant kinetic bombardment from the liquid molecules.
